text:
Hannah Lee: EdgeScale (channel reseller) says Q1 invoices charged them list price, not their negotiated reseller tier discount. they're asking for retro credits and to pause auto-chargeback.
Mark R.: can you share invoice ids and contract?
Hannah Lee: INV-AZ-2026-01-1001, INV-AZ-2026-02-1002, INV-AZ-2026-03-1003. PDFs + pricing contract uploaded to s3://redwood-prod/finance/resellers/edgescale/
FinanceBot: Reconciliation job 2026-04-11 flagged pricing_mismatch for reseller EdgeScale. Case RB-9920 created.
Priya Singh: quick ledger check: ```sql
SELECT invoice_id, billed_rate, negotiated_rate, billed_amount, expected_amount
FROM reseller_invoices
WHERE reseller='EdgeScale' AND period LIKE '2026-Q1';
-- shows billed_rate=0.10/token, negotiated_rate=0.07/token, variance ~30%
```
Mark R.: looks like our reseller-pricing override layer didn't apply. i see a 404 in pricing-service logs for reseller id edgescale-az during pricing lookup on 2026-01-01.
Nate B.: if pricing-service returned 404 we fallback to list-price. i'll open INFRA-3212 and attach logs + trace id. we need to stop fallback to list-price for known resellers.
Hannah Lee: partner expects retro credit + assurance future invoices will honor tier. they want partner communication template.
Priya Singh: proposed next steps: 1) create credit memos for the three invoices with detailed breakdown 2) place temporary hold on auto chargebacks for EdgeScale 3) patch pricing-service lookup and redeploy 4) run invoice replay for affected period 5) route manager approval for reserve drawdown if required.
Mark R.: estimated credit across Q1 ~ $42,500. finance, can we absorb from reseller_reconciliation_reserve?
Priya Singh: policy allows reserve drawdown up to $50k with manager approval. i've queued approval ACK-8722.
FinanceBot: ACK-8722 created and linked to RB-9920. Recommended actions appended: "create_credit_memos;hold_auto_chargebacks;deploy_pricing_fix".
Nate B.: INFRA-3212 opened: "pricing-service: avoid list-price fallback for known resellers; ensure 404 triggers manual review". linking RB-9920 + ACK-8722. PR in review.
Hannah Lee: drafted partner note (apology + steps + timeline 5 business days to post credits). pasting for review.
Mark R.: message looks good. please send and CC legal for contract notification.
Priya Singh: accounting submitted CM-2026-Q1-ES-01, CM-2026-Q1-ES-02, CM-2026-Q1-ES-03 for approval.
FinanceBot: RB-9920 status set to 'in_progress'. reminder created for 2026-04-18 to confirm credits posted and replay completed.
Hannah Lee: thanks team — will update here when credits post and pricing fix rolls out.
